# ExLlamaV3 input

The [vcruz305 ExLlamaV3 fork](https://github.com/vcruz305/exllamav3) is pinned to `d968d96dbe56072317329d573bd06e1403eb949b`, version 1.6.1.post1. It extends Turboderp's ExLlamaV3 1.6.1 with GB10, mixed-K and cooperative MoE support. It retains the MIT licence under `exllamav3/LICENSE` in the staged context.
